reviews.title: Boring
reviews.text: If you are an educated person, this app will bore you. This is below high school level stuff. I wanted to like the app, because I love learning! But this app will insult your intelligence. If you get 100% on every quiz, it should progress to harder material. But it doesn’t, it stays on the same stupid nonsense. Example: Plato was a Greek _____ and student of Socrates. Choices: philosopher, god, wizard, or midwife. I mean, come on! All the AI art is disconcerting as well. Too bad.

reviews.title: What a joke

reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: I wasn’t very impressed with the Yuno app during the free trial, but I decided to give it another chance by signing up for a one-month subscription. Instead, I was charged $80 for a full year, which I did not intend to purchase. After contacting both Apple and Yuno support, each directed me to the other for a refund, leaving the issue unresolved. Overall, this has been a frustrating experience, and I feel misled by an app I didn’t find particularly useful.
